Phase 2B

Preparation

Get your Move ready

About 5 minutes
1 Back up your notes Open the reMarkable app and wait for sync to finish.
2 Enable Developer Mode Open Settings → General → Paper Tablet → Software → Advanced.
3 Copy the password Open Help → About → Copyrights and Licenses → General Information.
4 Enable the USB connection Connect the cable, then turn on Settings → Storage → USB web interface.
Where to find Developer Mode and the password

Developer ModeSettings → General → Paper Tablet → Software → Advanced → Developer Mode

Developer passwordSettings → General → Help → About → Copyrights and Licenses → General Information

USB connectionSettings → General settings → Storage → USB web interface → On

Before you continue

Know the risks

  • Independent project; not supported by reMarkable or OpenAI
  • Developer Mode reduces the Move's normal security
  • Updates may break custom software, so keep notes backed up
Read the full disclaimer

Paper Agent installs and modifies unofficial Developer Mode software. These changes can affect device stability, support eligibility, or locally stored data. Paper Agent backs up files it manages, but cannot guarantee recovery of unrelated device data. You are responsible for installing and using it.
